classified.summary: Xero is an online accounting software platform for small businesses that provides an API for third-party developers to access user data via OAuth 2.0.

detail: 3 of 6 setup items found in 7 pages

items.answer: The OAuth 2.0 spec (section 3.1.2 of RFC 6749) requires that a redirection URI must be an absolute URI. The use of wildcards in redirect URI is not supported. You can use up to 50 redirect URIs for your app.
Xero supports the Proof Key for Code Exchange (PKCE) extension to the authorization code flow. This allows native apps to securely connect to our API without needing to store a client secret.

Instead of broad access, your app now requests only the exact permissions it needs. If you call an endpoint that requires a granular scope you haven't requested yet, the API will return a 401 forbidden error with a response header WWW-Authenticate:insufficent_scope.

items.answer: App partners must undertake a security assessment which is reviewed by Xero’s security team. Apps are not certified or listed in the app marketplace without passing.

Apps may fail the security assessment if they do not meet requirements such as proper OAuth token management, TLS version 1.2 using AES 256 or higher, secure data hosting, or vulnerability management.

steps.d: Fill in the required Partner Login URL field in your app configuration screen.
Provide absolute redirect URIs, up to 50, without using wildcards.
Select the exact permissions your app needs instead of broad access.
Use PKCE for native apps to connect securely without storing a client secret.
